name: Homemade Smooth Garlic-Free Hummus (Blended Chickpea Puree)
whyItWorks: Made by boiling canned chickpeas with a pinch of baking soda so the skins slip off, then blending the inner flesh velvety smooth with extra-virgin olive oil, cumin, and sea salt with ZERO raw garlic. High protein and gentle.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer canned chickpeas for 10 minutes, pinch off loose skins, and puree in a food processor with 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp warm water, and 1/2 tsp salt until ultra-creamy.
